hooks.name: broadcast_message
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's BroadcastMessageEvent)

rust_summary: A server system broadcast line, rewritable or cancellable (`native_broadcast_message`).
doc_summary: A system broadcast line is about to be logged and sent to every player: `native_broadcast_message(line, cancel)` lets a mod rewrite it or set `cancel` to drop it. Bundles need "hooks": @API:broadcast_message@.
